title: State renaming of the initial buffer configuration
statement: Let $k$ be a positive integer, let $S,T$ be sets, let $f:S\to T$, let $s\in S$, and let $x,w$ be Boolean words. Renaming the state of the initial $k$-tape configuration on input $x$, with $w$ stored on the first work tape, by $f$ gives exactly the corresponding configuration with initial state $f(s)$.
